title: Northgate Store and Online Orders: Pickup Holds, Cancellation Statuses and Delivery Changes
content:
For **Northgate Store and Online Orders**, the figures governing pickup holds, cancellation, large-item delivery changes and missing-item reports differ by program as follows.

| Program | Calendar days after the ready date a ready order is held | Refund when a ready order is not collected in time | Statuses in which the customer may cancel | Hours before the scheduled date (large items) | Delivery reschedules carrying no fee | Days after fulfilment to report a missing or damaged-on-arrival item | Photo ID checked at pickup |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate In-Store Purchase | 0 | not applicable | none (the sale is complete at the register) | 0 | 0 | 0 | no |
| Northgate Order Pickup | 5 | the full order amount | placed | 0 | 0 | 2 | yes |
| Northgate Drive Up | 5 | the full order amount | placed | 0 | 0 | 2 | no |
| Northgate Ship to Home | 0 | not applicable | placed | 0 | 0 | 30 | no |
| Northgate Same-Day Delivery | 0 | not applicable | placed | 0 | 0 | 2 | no |
| Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery | 0 | not applicable | placed | 48 | 2 | 2 | no |

**Meaning of each column, as published.**
- Hold days: calendar days after the ready date during which a ready order is held for collection; 0 where there is no pickup step.
- Unclaimed refund: the refund made when a ready order is not collected within the hold period.
- Cancellation statuses: order statuses in which the customer may cancel; empty where the sale is complete at the register.
- Cutoff hours: hours before the scheduled delivery date before which a large-item order can be canceled or rescheduled without a fee; 0 where not applicable.
- Free reschedules: the number of delivery reschedules made before the cutoff that carry no fee; 0 where not applicable.

**Rule in force for Northgate Scheduled Large-Item Delivery reschedules and cancellations.** A Scheduled Large-Item Delivery appointment may be rescheduled by the customer at any time down to the scheduled day itself, whatever tender paid the order: the program's free reschedules made two or more days ahead carry no fee, and every other reschedule carries the late-change fee. A reschedule requested two or more calendar days ahead of the scheduled date while the customer's confirmed reschedule requests already on the order are fewer than the program's free reschedules is a free reschedule and carries no late-change fee; every other reschedule carries the late-change fee. A large-item order canceled within the cutoff hours of its scheduled date, beyond the free reschedules, still carries the program's late cancellation fee.
- Report days: calendar days after fulfilment within which a missing or damaged-on-arrival item can be reported for a refund without a return.

**Hypothetical reading.** A Ship to Home order fulfilled on a given day may have a missing item reported up to the thirtieth calendar day after it; a Drive Up order only up to the second.
